$comment: Per-type positive list of Swift identities approved for [StructLayout(Sequential)] emission. Baseline is empty — default storage strategy is VWT-backed opaque. The whitelist is a second gate on top of storage_strategy=sequential / sequential_layout_whitelisted=true in manifest.json; the emitter ALSO requires frozen=true, non-generic, validated size+alignment, and a complete sequential_layout_evidence block (stored_fields_known, copy_destroy_handling ∈ {trivial, explicit_vwt}, roundtrip_validated) before honoring an entry. An opt-in with any of those missing is refused: the type still emits via the VWT-opaque fallback so consumers don't lose it, but the CLI fails the build.
